I am turning over why the navbar on trycapture.app feels awkward and whether the pricing page makes Cloud yearly at $50/yr clear enough. I am not sure what the right layout is yet.

Separately, I am wondering why my Askde posts sound robotic. Maybe the tone is too polished, but I am still thinking about what sounding human would mean for the posting strategy.
The navbar feels cramped, and the mobile navigation spacing seems too tight. These are two observations about the same goal: making Capture navigation comfortable to use.
I need to call the dentist and buy milk on the way home.
